title: freeze-build
responsibility: Gives the browser run it belongs to its own checked copy of the finished build and prints where it is.

outputs.name: stdout
outputs.description: The single JSON line written to stdout after frozenBuild succeeds. build is the per-run copy under the repository's .cache/reports-e2e/<run>/build; buildId is the 64-character SHA-256 identity shared by the source before copying, the copied files and the source after copying; files is the number of files included in that identity. On failure, the script writes the error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when e2eFixtures finds HARNESS_E2E_ROOT unset or empty, so the process belongs to no browser run and no build is copied. The script prints the error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when the source directory is missing, cannot be listed, or contains no files, so frozenBuild cannot identify a build to copy. The script prints the error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A filesystem error while removing the previous per-run copy, copying source files, or reading build files. frozenBuild propagates the error without an additional cleanup attempt; the script prints its message to stderr and exits with status 1.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when the source identity changes during copying or the copied files do not match the original identity. frozenBuild removes the copied directory before throwing; the script prints the error message to stderr and exits with status 1.
